notes.title: 2024-09-15 Update
notes.content:
HCG Fix
Fixed an issue where character costume parts were displayed abnormally in certain animations.
Resource Optimization
Resolved an issue where performance significantly slowed down when entering the extra room.
Thank you.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Bug fix
Fixed character movement bug in Stage 2
Applied full screen change
Thank you.

notes.title: 2024-09-09 update
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the latest update on Steam:
- Main engine upgrade and C++ native conversion provide a smoother gaming experience.
- The Spine update has increased the resolution of illustrations.
- The attack style of the Energy Gun has been changed.

Thank you!
